A band of light that sweeps across text for in-progress states, tinted from the text color and still under reduced motion.
Color of the highlight, from the theme or arbitrary. Takes an opacity modifier.
Direction and breakpoints
For placeholder blocks rather than text, use <0>Skeleton</0>, which shimmers surfaces with the theme's `animate-shimmer`.
In right-to-left layouts the sweep reverses, so it still travels in reading direction.
Keep it to a line or two. A shimmering paragraph is tiring to read.
Length of one sweep in milliseconds.
Options
Put the text in a `role="status"` region when it changes, so the new step is announced. The shimmer itself is decoration.
Shimmer is a Tailwind utility from shadcn's `tailwind.css`. The HextaUI theme already imports it, so if you've added the theme or any component, you have it.
Shimmer while a task runs, then sweep once with `shimmer-once` when it finishes. Changing the key restarts the sweep for each new step.
Shimmer: loading text effect for Tailwind CSS
Speed, band width, color and angle are each one class.
Status updates
Sweeps a highlight across the text, every 2s.
Sweeps in the opposite direction.
Sweeps once instead of repeating.

The text is painted with a gradient through `background-clip: text`, and a lighter band slides across it. The band is derived from the text's own color, so it suits muted, foreground or colored text without configuration, and it brightens in dark mode, where a lighter band reads better.
The text stays real text: selectable, searchable and read normally by screen readers.
Tilt of the band. Defaults to 20°.
Turns it off, for example at a breakpoint.
Under reduced motion the gradient is removed entirely and the text renders in its normal color.

Use it on short text that describes work in progress, like an assistant thinking, a file processing or a step that's running. The moving highlight says "still working" without a spinner taking up space beside the words.
Width of the band on the spacing scale, or any length. Defaults to 3ch + 40px.
Without the theme, install `shadcn` and import its CSS after Tailwind.
